scope: Synthetic behavioral challenge. New generators and evaluation seeds; not independent of control design, not exchange rejection emulation, not externally labeled real-market data. Labels are declared review expectations, not legal conclusions.
method: Binary unit = (episode, participant, control); repeated alerts count once in precision/recall, but individually in false-alert rate. Gap episodes evaluate REC-01 only on a synthetic stream unit. Delay is first emission minus episode start; finalization-only findings use session end. 95% intervals resample seeds, retaining every scenario within a seed; they do not quantify real-market uncertainty. Sensitivity scales five documented thresholds without selecting a winner.
